date_from.description: Absolute ISO timestamp lower bound for the event scan — pass the session's start so older sessions resolve. Defaults to a 7-day lookback when omitted or unparseable.

filter_test_accounts.description: Whether to also apply the project's internal and test user filters (its test_account_filters setting) on top of `properties`.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this mcp analytics submission.

limit.description: Maximum tool calls to return per page (1–500). Defaults to 500 — the whole page — so a session's calls come back in one request; pass a smaller value for a lighter response. Values above the cap are rejected.

offset.description: Number of tool calls to skip before returning results. Combine with limit to page through a session's calls; the response's has_next flag indicates whether more remain.

properties.description: Property filters that narrow the underlying $mcp_tool_call events, JSON-encoded. A list of event, person, or session property filters, each with key, value, operator, and type. Example: [{"key": "$mcp_tool_name", "value": ["query_run"], "operator": "exact", "type": "event"}]
